ordinary_conservative_rule: report date plus 8 calendar days at 00:00 UTC
exception_rule: max(ordinary conservative availability, UTC midnight after official actual publication date)
notes: The 2019 press release specifies the first catch-up report on 2019-02-01 and then one chronological report each Tuesday and Friday until current; the listed mapping applies that official sequence.
The 2023 and revised 2025 mappings are stated report-date-to-publication-date mappings in official CFTC announcements.
Using UTC midnight after publication is deliberately later than the official 15:30 America/New_York release time.
